You become the main character,
exploring the world of POKéMON-\xFABy talking to people and solving\xFAmysteries, new paths will open to you-\xFAStrive for the goal together with your\xFAwonderful POKéMON-

When you come across another person,
go up to them and press the A Button-\xFAThat will get them to talk and interact\xFAwith your character- You may also\xFAexamine various items and objects in\xFAthe same way- Talk to people and check\xFAthings often to obtain information-

On the stairs or the exits of a
building is a red mat- Move your\xFAcharacter to stand on top of the\xFAred mat- Press the \xF9Ç Control Pad \xFAtoward the stairs or the exit to\xFAadvance-

This isn$t something you should worry
about too much-\xFATalk to other people, check signs,\xFAcheck things, and so on-\xFASometimes, you may need to just move\xFAto a new town or place-

Try moving on to a new road, town, or
place-

There could be something in the town
or inside a building that is the cause-\xFATry talking to the people in the area\xFAagain- If there is a problem that they\xFAneed solved, you may have to help-\xFAAfterwards, try talking to the person\xFAblocking your way again-

Try talking to people by going up to
them and pressing the A Button-\xFAAlso, try checking things like odd trees\xFAand strange rocks with the A Button-\xFAPress the \xF9Ç Control Pad and try going\xFAto places that look impassable, too-

Try going to places where you 
haven$t visited yet-\xFAAlso, check everything that looks\xFAsuspicious by pressing the A Button-

Any item that you are given by another
character goes in your BAG-\xFAThe item is automatically sorted and\xFAplaced in one of three pockets-\xFAFor instructions on the BAG$s use,\xFAplease refer to the HELP System$s\xFA"How do I do this?" heading-

If POKéMON are hurt in battle,
take them to a POKéMON CENTER and\xFAhave them healed by the staff-\xFAGet in the habit of saving your\xFAgame and recording your progress-\xFAStock up on healing items at\xFAPOKéMON MARTS before traveling far-

Forests are basically the same as
roads but they can be like mazes-\xFAAll forests have a way out, so don$t\xFAgive up if you get lost-

Caves are dark and dangerous- Wild
POKéMON can appear anywhere in them-\xFAIf there is an emergency, rush to a\xFAPOKéMON CENTER or use items-\xFANew towns await discovery beyond some\xFAcaves, so don$t give up-

The object of the game is to train
your POKéMON and move forward-\xFAYou must collect info and solve\xFAproblems- For example, what do you\xFAneed to get around an obstacle?\xFAWhat would get that impeding\xFAperson out of the way?

There are several kinds of items-
Some can be used only on the field-\xFASome are only for use during battle-\xFASome can be used anytime-\xFATry using an item . if it can$t be used,\xFAyou will be alerted-

In a battle, POKéMON try to reduce
one another$s vitality, expressed as\xFAHP- If a POKéMON$s HP falls to zero,\xFAit faints, and the other POKéMON\xFAwins- By winning a battle, POKéMON\xFAearn EXP- Points, which help them\xFAlevel up \grow stronger]-

First, fully heal the POKéMON in your
party \the POKéMON with you] at any\xFAPOKéMON CENTER-\xFAYou should also buy healing items for\xFAemergencies at a POKéMON MART-

A POKéMON$s vitality is expressed in HP-
If a POKéMON is hurt in battle, HP is\xFAsubtracted- If its HP drops to zero,\xFAthe POKéMON faints-\xFAHeal hurt or fainted POKéMON at a\xFAPOKéMON CENTER or by using items-

A POKéMON CENTER is like an inn for
POKéMON- It will fully heal POKéMON of\xFAany status problems and fully restore\xFAtheir HP using a special machine-\xFAThis service is free, so get in the\xFAhabit of healing your POKéMON often-

A status problem refers to an ailment
that is inflicted on a POKéMON by its\xFAfoe$s attack- These include burns,\xFAparalysis, poisoning, sleep, and\xFAfreezing- These can be healed by\xFAvisiting a POKéMON CENTER or using\xFAthe appropriate item-

If all the POKéMON in your party
\all the POKéMON with you] faint, you\xFAlose some MONEY, and you are\xFAreturned home or to a POKéMON\xFACENTER- To reduce that chance, visit\xFAPOKéMON CENTERS often- Also, get\xFAin the habit of saving often-

If a wild POKéMON escapes from a POKé
BALL, it$s obviously still feisty-\xFATry reducing its HP some more, and\xFAtry to weaken it with paralysis or sleep\xFAbefore trying to catch it-\xFAIf the POKé BALL rocks for a while,\xFAthe quarry is close to being caught!

There are shops, known as POKéMON
MARTS, that sell items-\xFAYou will not find POKéMON MARTS on\xFAroads, in forests, or in caves-\xFAStock up on needed items while you are\xFAvisiting a town with a POKéMON MART-

POKéMON MART in any town-\xFAYou will not find POKéMON MARTS on\xFAroads, in forests, or in caves-\xFAStock up on POKé BALLS while you are\xFAvisiting a town with a POKéMON MART-

A TRAINER is a person who raises
POKéMON through battling-\xFATRAINERS will challenge you \xFAwherever they are . it could be on\xFAa road, in forests, caves, anywhere-\xFAIf your eyes meet, you have to accept\xFAtheir challenge- So be careful!

To beat a TRAINER in battle, use
POKéMON that have type advantages\xFAover the foe$s POKéMON- You may also\xFAuse highly trained POKéMON with\xFAoverwhelming power- Outnumbering the\xFAfoe$s POKéMON is another obvious\xFAtactic-

Wild POKéMON will appear in tall grass,
on roads, and in forests- They will\xFAappear anywhere in dark caves-\xFAThere are no wild POKéMON or TRAINERS\xFAin towns, so they are safe places-

POKéMON may learn up to four different
techniques, or moves- There is a great\xFAvariety of moves including attacks and\xFAthose with special effects- The kinds\xFAof moves that can be learned vary\xFAfor each POKéMON- Some moves\xFAcan be learned from machines-

moves- They are learned as the\xFAPOKéMON levels up- It can also be\xFAtaught a move using a TM \Technical\xFAMachine] or HM \Hidden Machine]-\xFAThere are also people who teach moves-

The key to making your POKéMON
strong is to battle and win often-\xFAThe EXP- \Experience] Points earned\xFAby winning battles accumulate to\xFAlevel up POKéMON that participated in\xFAthem- Battle wild POKéMON often to\xFAlevel up your party-

leveling up your POKéMON some more-\xFAGo back the way you came and battle\xFAwild POKéMON to level up your party-\xFAYou may also battle TRAINERS whom you\xFAhave not battled before-

Unlike roads and forests, wild POKéMON
can appear anywhere in caves-\xFAIf your POKéMON are hurt in a cave,\xFArush to a POKéMON CENTER or use items\xFAto heal them right away- It is very\xFAdangerous to force your luck in caves-

Believe in yourself and find your way!

red roof and a "P-C" sign- Every\xFAPOKéMON CENTER offers such services as\xFAfully healing POKéMON and free PC use,\xFAmaking it essential for your travels-\xFAOn the upper floor are facilities for\xFAlinking with friends and others-

blue roof and a "MART" sign-\xFAItems can be bought and sold at any\xFAPOKéMON MART- Some MARTS carry items\xFAthat are available only in their towns-

selecting "SAVE" on the MENU-\xFAOnce you have saved, the game can be\xFAsafely turned off- When the game is\xFAturned back on, you can resume from\xFAwhere you last saved-

POKéMON are living beings about which
many mysteries still remain- You may\xFAsee them in grass, the sea, and caves-\xFAThey appear to obey the wishes of the\xFATRAINERS that caught them-

Use the FAME CHECKER among the
KEY ITEMS in your BAG-\xFAIt may give you a hint, so try it out-

using an HM \Hidden Machine]-\xFAA HIDDEN move is important for helping\xFAyour adventure- For example, one is\xFAused to light up dark caves- Another\xFAcuts down small trees- There is one\xFAfor traveling on water, and so on-

Try to catch wild POKéMON by throwing
the special SAFARI BALLS-\xFAYou may keep any item you find, too-

Your SAFARI GAME ends once you have
traveled a certain distance or thrown\xFAall your SAFARI BALLS-\xFAOpen the MENU to check the remaining\xFAnumber of steps and SAFARI BALLS-

HP indicates a POKéMON$s vitality-
If a POKéMON$s HP drops to zero, it\xFAfaints and is unable to battle-\xFASo, the key in battle is to try to\xFAreduce the foe$s HP to zero-\xFAIf your POKéMON are hurt, restore their\xFAHP at a POKéMON CENTER or use items-

EXP- Points stands for "Experience
Points-" POKéMON gain EXP- Points by\xFAparticipating in winning battles-\xFAWhen a POKéMON accumulates sufficient\xFAEXP- Points, it levels up- The EXP- Bar\xFAindicates accumulated EXP- Points-\xFAIt returns to zero upon leveling up-

POKéMON may learn up to four different
moves- There are many kinds of moves\xFAincluding attacks and those with\xFAspecial effects- The kinds of moves\xFAthat can be learned vary for each\xFAPOKéMON- Some moves can be learned\xFAfrom items-

ATTACK indicates the power of an
offensive move- The higher this stat,\xFAthe more powerful the move-\xFAIt is applied for the following move\xFAtypes: NORMAL, POISON, GROUND,\xFAFLYING, BUG, FIGHTING, ROCK, GHOST,\xFAand STEEL-

DEFENSE indicates the resistance a
POKéMON has against physical attacks-\xFAThe higher this stat, the less damage\xFAsustained from a foe$s physical hit-

SP- ATK \Special Attack] indicates the
power of a special attack move-\xFAThe higher this stat, the more powerful\xFAthe special attack move-\xFAIt is applied for the following move\xFAtypes: FIRE, WATER, ELECTRIC, GRASS,\xFAICE, PSYCHIC, DRAGON, and DARK-

SP- DEF \Special Defense] indicates
the resistance a POKéMON has against\xFAspecial attacks-\xFAThe higher this stat, the less damage\xFAsustained from a foe$s special attack-

SPEED indicates the agility of a
POKéMON- If this stat exceeds the foe$s\xFAin battle, the POKéMON can make a move\xFAbefore its slower opponent-

Lv- \Level] indicates the growth and
strength of a POKéMON-\xFAIn general, when a POKéMON levels up,\xFAits stats such as HP, ATTACK, and\xFADEFENSE rise, making it stronger-\xFAPOKéMON may learn a new move upon\xFAleveling up-

POKéMON and moves are classified by
type- Every type has advantageous and\xFAdisadvantageous matchups against\xFAother types- For example, like a rock.\xFApaper.scissors game, the WATER type is\xFAstrong against the FIRE type and weak\xFAagainst the GRASS type-

OT stands for "Original TRAINER,"
the first TRAINER to have caught the\xFAselected POKéMON-\xFAEven if the POKéMON is traded, the OT\xFAname will remain unchanged-

All POKéMON can be made to hold one
item each- Some items will be used by\xFAthe POKéMON automatically in certain\xFAsituations- To make a POKéMON hold an\xFAitem, select the item from the BAG and\xFA"GIVE" it to the POKéMON-

All POKéMON have a special ABILITY-
There are many different kinds of these\xFAabilities, some used in battle, some\xFAelsewhere- The abilities differ from\xFAspecies to species- Some species may\xFAhave more than one kind of ability-

Whenever you win a battle against a
TRAINER, you are given prize money-\xFASave up your prize money so you can\xFAenjoy shopping at POKéMON MARTS!

Moves are also classified by types-
If a POKéMON of a certain type uses\xFAa move of the same type, the move$s\xFApower is boosted- If the move$s type\xFAhas a matchup advantage against the\xFAtarget, its effectiveness is also\xFAboosted-

All POKéMON have a personality,
or "NATURE-" The POKéMON$s\xFAnature appears to affect how the\xFAPOKéMON will grow upon leveling up-

The ID No- is a special number assigned
specifically to you as a TRAINER-\xFATogether with the OT name, the ID No-\xFAis used to precisely identify the\xFAOriginal TRAINER-\xFAThe ID No- does not change even if the\xFAPOKéMON is traded-

PP stands for "Power Points-"
It indicates the number of times a\xFAcertain move can be used in battle-\xFALike HP, PP can be restored by visiting\xFAa POKéMON CENTER or using certain\xFAitems-

POWER indicates the strength of an
attack- The higher this number, the\xFAgreater the damage that can be\xFAinflicted on the foe!

ACCURACY indicates the probability of
the move hitting the foe-\xFAThe higher this number, the more likely\xFAthe move will strike the target-

FNT stands for "fainted-"
A POKéMON faints if its HP is reduced\xFAto zero- It becomes incapable of taking\xFApart in battle-\xFARestore a fainted POKéMON at a POKéMON\xFACENTER, or use an item-

MART are placed in the ITEMS POCKET-\xFAItems may be used, given to a POKéMON\xFAto hold, or tossed out as garbage-
